_help.units: program lengths are feet; the hand-off to design_pipeline is mm (X east, Y north, origin = plot south-west corner)
_help.wall_mm: wall thickness used to inset unit outlines (taken as wall centrelines) in output/plan_trace.json
_help.typology:
pinned typology id (empty until the P2 match decision; per parcel in parcels/

/parcel.json when parcels is true)
_help.typology_version: exact version; older versions load from typologies/<ID>/versions/
_help.variant: folder of a project-local variant (extends a registered typology); overrides typology
_help.parcels: true: P1b splits the site and each parcel pins its own typology
